storyCards.headline: Sorry: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Justin Bieber's "Sorry" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Sorry" is a song recorded by Canadian singer Justin Bieber for his fourth studio album, Purpose (2015).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 42 weeks on the chart.

Sorry was released in 2015.
